jobs.title: Sales Manager Team Lead
jobs.description:

Taptica is a global end-to-end mobile advertising platform that helps the world’s top brands reach their most valuable users with the widest range of traffic sources available today. Our proprietary technology leverages big data, and combined with state-of-the-art machine learning, enables quality media targeting at scale. You will be directly responsible for aggressively expanding our international portfolio of app developers and mobile advertisers, securing high-value, strategic UA budgets, and establishing long-term, profitable partnerships that fuel their user growth and drive our company's meaningful business expansion.

You will also serve as manager of our Sales team, leading and developing the team to hit performance and revenue goals.

 - Build and manage a robust sales pipeline by employing efficient lead generation, proactive outreach, and strategic networking within the mobile app ecosystem.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Technical Integrations
jobs.description:
About the Role

Nexxen's SSP connects publishers to programmatic demand across web, ctv mobile app and mobile web. Because publishers integrate with us in different ways, we need someone who can be the technical expert across openRTB, prebid.js, mediation SDKs.

This role owns the technical, end to end integrations with publishers: helping publishers implement and troubleshoot their chosen integration path, validating that ad requests and responses are flowing correctly, and translating publisher feedback and issues into clear requirements for product and engineering. This role is based in our Tel Aviv office and works daily with publishers, partners, and colleagues across global markets. You'll report into Product, working closely with SSP product leadership and platform engineering to make sure integrations are scoped accurately, shipped reliably, and supported after launch.

What You'll Do

 - Serve as the primary technical point of contact for publisher integrations across all three paths into the SSP: third-party mobile mediation SDKs, Prebid client-side wrappers, and direct server-to-server OpenRTB.

 - Support commercial teams and provide technical guidance for publishers through implementation — reviewing their mediation SDK setup, Prebid config (ad units, params, adapter/module set), or OpenRTB request construction — and troubleshoot integration issues end to end.

 - Review publishers’ integration specs and requirements, and analyze and validate bid request/response payloads (OpenRTB) and Prebid.js configurations to confirm parameters are being passed, parsed, and rendered correctly across each integration path.

 - Apply a working understanding of ad delivery and rendering (including VAST-based video ad delivery on web) to debug tag/creative rendering, tracking, and playback issues raised by publishers.

 - Translate publisher technical questions, bug reports, and ad hoc requirements into clear, structured input that product and engineering can act on.
